How to Add a New Membership Plan

Membership plans control what members can do on your directory and how much they pay.

Create the plan

  1. Go to Members > Membership Plans in the admin area.
  2. Click Add New Plan.
  3. Enter the plan name, the price and the billing cycle (monthly or yearly).
  4. Click Save Changes.

Free plans

Set the price to 0 to create a free plan. Free plans never charge the member.
